about: A tool that keeps terminal sessions running in the background, so you can leave and come back to them.

prs.title: Accented letters and symbols survive in command output
prs.broken: Output from commands run through the tool lost every accented letter, euro sign or non-English character. Some names could even make whole lines vanish.
prs.changed: The tool now keeps those characters as they are while reading the output.
prs.matters: Output in any language comes back exactly as the command printed it.

prs.title: A -d meant for the command is left alone
prs.broken: The tool treated any -d on the line as its own option to run in the background, even when it belonged to the command. Commands like cut -d or date -d then ran without it.
prs.changed: The tool now only reads its own options before the command starts.
